title: Crime and Society
sources_used: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: “Are all criminals treated equally in front of law”. Substantiate your answer. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Criminals are not treated equally because factors like class, caste, and power influence
  • how laws are enforced.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Evaluate how one’s society can influence crime rate. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Society influences crime through social norms, inequalities, and differential access to
  • opportunities.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: State the concept of domestic violence within the family . / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Domestic violence refers to physical, emotional, or psychological abuse within family
  • or intimate relationships.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define probation . / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Probation is a non-custodial punishment allowing offenders to remain in society under
  • supervision.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Examine the importance of criminology as a learning domain. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Criminology is important as it studies causes, prevention, and control of criminal
  • behaviour.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Analyse the role of social reaction in defining deviance according to Howard Becker. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Becker argued that deviance is defined through social reactions and labeling by
  • society.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: “Crime is seen as a product of evolutionary adaptation”- explain. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Evolutionary theory views crime as adaptive behaviour linked to survival and
  • competition.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: State the major forms of online harrasement . / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • Online harassment includes cyberbullying, stalking, trolling, and digital abuse.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain Sutherland’s concept of “definitions favorable to law violation” in Differential Association Theory. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Sutherland meant that criminal behaviour is learned through exposure to definitions
  • favourable to law violation.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain how evolutionary theories interpret aggression and risk-taking as causes of criminal behavior. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Evolutionary theories link aggression and risk-taking to survival instincts and
  • reproductive success.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain how over-compensation can lead to juvenile delinquency. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Over-compensation may lead juveniles to delinquency as they attempt to assert
  • identity or overcome inferiority.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Briefly explain Strain theory by RK Merton. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Merton’s strain theory states that blocked access to goals leads individuals to
  • deviance.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the meaning of legal remedy / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • Legal remedy refers to means provided by law to enforce rights or seek justice.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain how psychological causes can lead to crime. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Psychological causes such as trauma, frustration, or personality disorders may lead to
  • crime.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Write a short note on physical/biological causes of crime. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Biological causes include genetic predisposition and neurological or hormonal
  • influences.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain how an individuals surroundings or neighborhood can influence their criminal behaviour. / [CO3] [2x13 = 26]
questions.solution_html:
• Neighbourhood conditions like poverty and social disorganization can increase
  • criminal tendencies.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
